title: Service accounts
explain: A service account is an identity for a tool (CI, monitoring, home automation). It has no password and cannot log in, only keys. You are responsible for it, and it holds the rights you hold, as they are at each call.
name: Name (it becomes svc-name)
shownOnce: Copy the key now: it is shown only once.
oauthHint: For tools that need OAuth2: the client id is the part after arm_ and before the second underscore, the client secret the rest; ask POST /api/v1/oauth/token with grant_type=client_credentials.
